phase: written before the first specdet run

model_scope.state: positive capacity, finite key-to-value map, duplicate-free MRU-to-LRU key sequence with exactly the map domain
model_scope.input: the complete old logical state and operation arguments
model_scope.observation: return Option<u64> and complete new logical state (capacity, contents, MRU order)
model_scope.representation: Ghost map/order are an abstraction of the Rust hash map and doubly-linked list; no physical address, allocation, hasher, or sentinel state is modeled

source_reading.put: Existing keys return the old value and move to MRU; absent keys return None, including when inserting at capacity and evicting the LRU.
source_reading.get: A hit returns the stored value and promotes the key to MRU; a miss returns None and preserves all state.
source_reading.pop: A hit removes the key and returns its old value; a miss returns None; surviving entries retain their relative recency order.
source_reading.ordering: iter() publicly exposes MRU-to-LRU order, and the order determines future eviction; it is not treated as hidden state.

prior_expectation: All three contracts should be observationally deterministic. I have included all state frames and complete survivor order, and have not knowingly inserted an underconstraint.
not_claimed: No proof that the original unsafe Rust code refines this model.
No claim about generic keys with distinguishable equal representations, custom hashers, panicking Drop/Hash/Eq, allocation failure, timing, raw pointers, or reference identity.
Determinism would not by itself prove satisfiability, intent adequacy, memory safety, termination, or equivalence to the implementation.
A later intentionally removed clause must be labeled a known mutation control, not an unanticipated discovery.
revision_policy: Preserve the sealed first candidate and first result. Revise a contract only for a source-supported semantic reason or a documented, separately hashed encoding repair. Keep the same complete observation across comparisons.
